abstraction_design.rationale: The right abstractions exist where variation is real (card, species-card builder, facts helpers), but page scaffolding (card lists, facts dl, loading wrapper) is copy-pasted rather than lifted, so each new similar page adds ~4 duplicated blocks.

findings.issue: All loader return values are `any` and routes consume them untyped (`data: any` at app/src/routes/pokemon/[name].tsx:22); the whole app has one type line, so the api.ts↔routes contract is invisible and renames fail silently.
findings.suggestion: Define and export interfaces for each loader's return shape in lib/api.ts and use them in queries.ts and route props.

findings.issue: The `<ul class="card-grid">` + `<For>` + `PokemonCard` list is duplicated in four routes (also index.tsx:131, abilities/[name].tsx:29, types/[name].tsx:48), so any cross-list change (sorting, layout, empty state) is a four-file edit.
findings.suggestion: Extract a `CardList` component that owns the ul/For/count rendering and accepts the cards array plus optional sort.

findings.issue: The card record `{id, name, sprite}` is assembled twice — in `toSpeciesCards` (api.ts:76-90) and again in `loadHomeData` (api.ts:124-130) — so a sprite/card bug fix must be applied in both spots of the same file.
findings.suggestion: Have loadHomeData build its species entries through (or share a mapping helper with) the same card-shape code path.

findings.issue: The subtle loading-vs-not-found pattern (`Show when={data()} fallback={<Show when={data() === null}>…}`) is duplicated in all four detail routes.
findings.suggestion: Extract a small `DetailPage`/`withNotFound` wrapper (or a route-level helper) that owns the undefined/null distinction once.

findings.issue: Type-badge link markup (`A` with `type-badge`/`data-type`) is repeated in five places (also pokemon/[name].tsx:56 and :287, types/[name].tsx:32, moves/[name].tsx:26).
findings.suggestion: Add a `TypeBadge` component and use it everywhere; future styling/aria changes then touch one file.

findings.issue: The description-list ('facts') markup is inlined and duplicated with the Pokémon detail page's version (pokemon/[name].tsx:62) rather than a shared component, which the planned Items section would copy a third time.
findings.suggestion: Extract a `FactList` component taking [{term, description}] — it generalizes cleanly since entries are just label/value pairs.

findings.issue: `nitro: ^3.0.261029-rc` uses a caret on a date-stamped RC, so installs can float across future RCs with breaking changes.
findings.suggestion: Pin the RC exactly and bump deliberately once Nitro v3 stable lands (SolidStart v2 docs recommend the `nitro` package, so the dependency itself is correct).

summary: A clean three-tier layout (server-only api.ts, thin 'use server' queries, self-contained routes) on a fully current SolidStart v2 stack makes removal and data-layer fixes mechanical, and the sprite bug would be fixed in exactly one module. The costs are copy-pasted page scaffolding — card lists, loading wrappers, facts dl, type badges — and an entirely untyped loader contract that forces grepping instead of compiler-assisted edits. Overall a solid PR with one refactoring pass (shared list/facts components + exported types) standing between it and exemplary.
